about_short_description.short_description: Bounce provides luggage storage for travelers and tourists in cities across the world.

product.name: Bounce Luggage Storage
product.description: A global luggage and personal-item storage service that lets travelers reserve space at local shops, hotels, lockers, and other partner locations for short- or multi-day storage.

product.name: Bounce Delivery
product.description: A luggage delivery service that sends travelers’ bags to a future destination for pickup, allowing them to travel between locations without carrying their luggage.

identifier.value: Bounce App and Online Booking Platform

product.name: Bounce App and Online Booking Platform
product.description: A web and mobile booking platform for finding, reserving, and managing Bounce storage and delivery services, including bag counts, dates, pickup times, changes, cancellations, and booking confirmations.
